[D1:1] Gina: Hey Jon! Good to see you. What's up? Anything new?
[D1:2] Jon: Hey Gina! Good to see you too. Lost my job as a banker yesterday, so I'm gonna take a shot at starting my own business.
[D1:3] Gina: Sorry about your job Jon, but starting your own business sounds awesome! Unfortunately, I also lost my job at Door Dash this month. What business are you thinking of?
[D1:4] Jon: Sorry to hear that! I'm starting a dance studio 'cause I'm passionate about dancing and it'd be great to share it with others.
[D1:5] Gina: That's cool, Jon! What got you into this biz?
[D1:6] Jon: I've been into dancing since I was a kid and it's been my passion and escape. I wanna start a dance studio so I can teach others the joy that dancing brings me.
[D1:7] Gina: Wow Jon, same here! Dance is pretty much my go-to for stress relief. Got any fave styles?
[D1:8] Jon: Cool, Gina! I love all dances, but contemporary is my top pick. It's so expressive and powerful! What's your fave?
[D1:9] Gina: Yeah, me too! Contemporary dance is so expressive and graceful - it really speaks to me.
[D1:10] Jon: Wow, great idea! Let's go to a dance class, it'll be so much fun!
[D1:11] Gina: Yeah! Let's explore some new dance moves. We should plan a dance session soon!
[D1:12] Jon: Yeah definitely! Wanna see my moves next Fri? Can't wait!
[D1:13] Gina: Sounds great, Jon! Next Friday works. Let's boogie!
[D1:14] Jon: Wow, I'm excited too! This is gonna be great!
[D1:15] Gina: Wow! What did you get?
[D1:16] Jon: Woah, that pic's from when my dance crew took home first in a local comp last year. It was amazing up on that stage! I'm super keen to spread that intensity with other peeps. Gina, you ever been in any dance comps or shows?
[D1:17] Gina: I used to compete in a few dance competitions and shows - my fav memory was when my team won first place at a regionals at age fifteen. It was an awesome feeling of accomplishment!
[D1:18] Jon: Wow! Winning first place is amazing! What dance were you doing?
[D1:19] Gina: Thanks! We just did a contemporary piece called "Finding Freedom." It was really emotional and powerful.
[D1:20] Jon: Wow, that must've been great! Check my ideal dance studio by the water.
[D1:21] Gina: Cool setup! Man, you can't deny that view! Got time to rehearse with a biz and a new store?
[D1:22] Jon: Hopefully, we will find a place like this that will inspire us!
[D1:23] Gina: Wow, it looks great! What dances do you practice? Got any projects planned?
[D1:24] Jon: Thanks! I rehearsed with a small group of dancers after work. We do all kinds of dances, from contemporary to hip-hop. We've got some cool projects in the works. Finishing up choreography to perform at a nearby festival next month. Can't wait!

[D18:1] Maria: Hey John, how're you doing? I'm sorry about Max. Losing a pet is tough. Some friends from church and I went camping last weekend - it was a blast! Just something nice to take my mind off things. Anything fun in your life lately?
[D18:2] John: Hey Maria, thanks for your kind words. It's still tough, but I'm finding some comfort in the good memories. Wow, your camping trip sounds awesome! I went on a mountaineering trip last week with some workmates. It was great and helped clear my head. Anything else cool happening in your life?
[D18:3] Maria: Glad you're finding comfort, John. That mountaineering trip sounds amazing. Did you reach the summit? When I was younger, my family and I went on a road trip to Oregon.
[D18:4] John: Thanks, Maria! Yeah, we made it to the top and the view was stunning. It was tough but awesome. Your family trip must have been great too, right? What was the prettiest spot?
[D18:5] Maria: Hiking to the top and seeing this was awesome! Breath-taking.
[D18:6] John: Wow, Maria! That waterfall and bridge look amazing! What a view. How was it being there?
[D18:7] Maria: I felt like I was in a fairy tale! The water sounded so calming and the surroundings were beautiful. It was truly magical!
[D18:8] John: Wow, Maria, that sounds awesome! It seems like nature has a way of calming us down, huh?
[D18:9] Maria: Yeah, it's like a natural soul-soother when things get tough.
[D18:10] John: Yeah, for sure. It's like a reset button, you know? Have you ever gone camping or mountain climbing before?
[D18:11] Maria: I've gone camping a few times but never tried mountain climbing. Sounds thrilling though! Have you been camping before?
[D18:12] John: Yeah, plenty of times. It's an awesome way to get away from it all and be at one with nature. I love how uncomplicated it is.
[D18:13] Maria: Yeah John, I get it. Being in nature helps us take a break from life's craziness and recognize what truly matters.
[D18:14] John: Yeah, Maria. It's important to appreciate the small things and find moments of peace amidst chaos. Nature really helps with that. How about you? How do you find peaceful moments?
[D18:15] Maria: Finding my Zen is a mix of things - a moment to myself plus favorite tunes is usually enough. I also enjoy aerial yoga, it's a great way to switch off and focus on my body.
[D18:16] John: Cool, Maria! Glad you found something that gives you some peace. Do you have a favorite yoga pose?
[D18:17] Maria: Thanks, John! It's tough to pick just one, but I really enjoy the upside-down poses. They make me feel free and light.
[D18:18] John: Wow, Maria, that sounds awesome! I can imagine that must be challenging, but it's great to see you embracing them. Keep up the amazing work!
[D18:19] Maria: Thanks, John! It can be tough, but aerial yoga is totally worth it. I love the freedom and connection it brings. Appreciate your support!
[D18:20] John: Yes, Maria! I'm here for you. Glad you found something that makes you happy. This is what makes me smile. Keep shining!
[D18:21] Maria: Wow! Looks like you had fun - what happened there?
[D18:22] John: It was an awesome day at the park with my family. The kids had a lot of fun on the playground, and we had some really nice family time.
[D18:23] Maria: Wow, that's great to hear, John! Cherish those family time moments!
[D19:1] Maria: Hey John, been good since we talked? I got some great news to share - I joined a gym last week! It's been super positive - I'm sticking to my workout routine and the people are awesome. The atmosphere is so welcoming.
[D19:2] John: Congrats, Maria! Sounds like it's been a great experience. Having a positive environment and supportive people can really help with motivation, right? So, do you have any fitness goals in mind?
[D19:3] Maria: Thanks, John! Yeah, it's been awesome. I want to get stronger and improve my endurance, and I'm trying kundalini yoga. What about you? Do you have any goals or activities you want to try?
[D19:4] John: Nice one, Maria! Staying in shape is important to me too. I'm trying out different workout regimes lately. Rock climbing sounds like a fun way to push my limits, have you ever given it a go?
[D19:5] Maria: No, I haven't tried it yet. But it sounds like a great way to push yourself. Let me know how it goes if you give it a shot!
[D19:6] John: Yeah, sure thing. I'll let you know. Oh, also...something massive happened since we last spoke. I got promoted at work! It's been a loooong time coming, and I'm over the moon about it!
[D19:7] Maria: Wow John! Congrats on the promotion! Must have taken a lot of work. How did you feel when you found out?
[D19:8] John: Thanks, Maria! I was really excited. It feels like all the hard work I've put in has paid off now that I'm an assistant manager- it's like a stepping stone for bigger things.
[D19:9] Maria: Wow, John! Congrats on the promotion! What's the backstory on that trophy?
[D19:10] John: Thanks, Maria! It commemorates my journey. It's a symbol of all the obstacles I had to overcome to get here.
[D19:11] Maria: Cool, so you have a reminder of all that. It's good to acknowledge what you've been through and appreciate where you are now. Could you tell me more about the challenges?
[D19:12] John: Yeah, I faced all kinds of hurdles - tech stuff, workplace stuff... but the worst was self-doubt. There were moments when I questioned if I was on the right track. But with support at home and my own grit, I powered through. This promotion is a reward for all the hustle and hardship I put in - a reminder that I'm on the right path.
[D19:13] Maria: Wow, John, it's incredible to see how far you've come! Your perseverance and determination is so inspiring. I can imagine those hurdles were tough to deal with, especially the self-doubt.
[D19:14] John: Thanks, Maria! It wasn't easy, but I'm proud of what I achieved. It can be tricky, but having support and believing in myself really helped me out.
[D19:15] Maria: Yeah John, having belief in yourself matters. Plus it helps a lot when you've got loved ones supporting you. What we can do is seriously incredible with the right people believing in us.
[D19:16] John: Definitely, Maria. Support from loved ones is vital. With their trust, we can do anything! I'm really lucky to have my family on this journey with me.
[D19:17] Maria: Nice workspace! When do you usually work?
[D19:18] John: Thanks, Maria! I usually work during regular work hours, but sometimes I bring work home too.
[D19:19] Maria: That work setup looks nice, John. How do you manage to balance everything?
[D19:20] John: Thanks, Maria! It can be challenging, so I try to organize my time and make sure I'm there for the important things. It's all about finding that balance and making those moments count!
[D19:21] Maria: Finding balance is crucial. Taking time for ourselves and the important people in our lives is vital.
[D19:22] John: Yeah, Maria. Taking time off for ourselves and our fam is so important. It helps us stay connected and appreciate the simple things. That beach pic you shared reminded me of a special vacation we had to California- a gorgeous sunset and an awesome night strolling the shore, creating memories together. Do you have any special beach memories you'd like to share?
[D19:23] Maria: Yeah, John! I have a picture from a vacation in Florida. The colors were amazing, and I had a feeling of gratitude just sitting there with my family. It's in moments like these we make the best memories, ya know?
[D19:24] John: Wow, Maria! That photo is so stunning. The colors there are so vivid - it must have been amazing! Trips like these are great - always full of amazing memories! Here's one from our vacation!
[D19:25] Maria: Thanks, John. That picture is so cute! The kids look so happy splashing in the waves. It must have been such a joyful and carefree time!
[D19:26] John: Yep, it was amazing. Enjoying these special family times is why life is great. Talk to you soon!
[D20:1] Maria: Hey John, long time no talk! A lot has happened since then. I've been struggling, but I'm focusing on the positive and relying on my friends and fam for support.
[D20:2] John: Hey Maria, sorry to hear that. That's rough, but it's great that you're focusing on the positive. Having support from your loved ones can make a big difference. How have they been helping you out?
[D20:3] Maria: Hey John, thanks. My family has been there for me all the way. They've been my rock, giving me words of encouragement and reminding me I'm not alone. It's a relief to have their support.
[D20:4] John: That's great, Maria! It's such a blessing to have family who always supports us and reminds us that we're not alone. They know us like no one else and stick by us no matter what. Last week, we had a blast at a live music event. Seeing them dancing and having fun was awesome. The energy in the air was amazing.
[D20:5] Maria: Wow, John! The energy from the crowd must have unreal! So glad you and your family got to experience that lively event. These are the moments that make the best memories.
[D20:6] John: Thanks, Maria! It was definitely an amazing experience. Moments like these remind me to appreciate the ones I love. Life can be tough, but finding silver linings helps me keep going. How have you been finding silver linings in tough times?
[D20:7] Maria: Volunteering at the shelter made me feel great to help, even if just for a bit.
[D20:8] John: Wow, Maria! That's really amazing. It must have felt great to help out. Do you have any special memories from your experience?
[D20:9] Maria: There are so many, but one that stands out was when I met someone special at the shelter. They'd been sad for months, but when I was playing with the kids, they suddenly laughed - it was so uplifting! I won't forget that.
[D20:10] John: That's a really nice memory, Maria! It's amazing how just playing with kids can bring such joy and happiness. It shows how even a brief moment with someone can make a difference. Thanks for sharing it with me.
[D20:11] Maria: No problem, John! It was really nice. Being able to make a difference brings me joy.
[D20:12] John: It's great knowing that our actions can brighten someone else's life. Keep it up!
[D20:13] Maria: Thanks, John! Gonna continue doing it - it's my way of spreading kindness and positivity.
[D20:14] John: Maria, that's great! Your way of passing on kindness and positivity is making a big impact on the world. You're really making a difference.
[D20:15] Maria: Thanks, John! Your words really mean a lot. It's always nice to know that what I'm doing is making an impact.
[D20:16] John: You definitely are. Keep going with it!
[D20:17] Maria: Thanks, John! I definitely will. Speak to you soon!
[D20:18] John: That's awesome, Maria! Keep that positivity going and keep making a difference. Take care!
[D21:1] Maria: Hey John, long time no see! Sorry I didn't get back to you sooner... So much has happened! Check out these kids I met at the shelter!
[D21:2] John: Hey Maria! Good to hear from you. Those little ones are adorable, any updates on them? How have you been?
[D21:3] Maria: Hey John! They were great, their smiles warmed my heart. But something not so great happened yesterday...
[D21:4] John: That's so sad. Can I do anything to help? What happened?
[D21:5] Maria: A car ran a red light and hit us, but thankfully everyone is okay. Besides that, my cousin just had a tough time recently, so I'm lending a hand in helping her find a new place.
[D21:6] John: That's really nice of you. It's important to help family during hard times. How is she doing now?
[D21:7] Maria: Things have been tough for her lately. She had to leave and find a new place in a hurry, which has been really stressful, but she's making progress.
[D21:8] John: The houses look real nice. Hopefully, she finds a cozy spot soon.
[D21:9] Maria: Yeah, that's important. A safe home is key.
[D21:10] John: Definitely, it's essential for wellbeing. It's great that you're supporting her. Is there anything specific she needs help with? Maybe I can assist as well.
[D21:11] Maria: Any resources or organizations you know of that could help her out? Thanks!
[D21:12] John: I'll see if I can find any that might be able to assist. Let me know if there's anything else I can do to help!
[D21:13] Maria: Thanks, John! Really appreciate your offer. Anything you can find would be great.
[D21:14] John: Sure, Maria! I'll do my best to find some resources. Helping those in need is important to me too.
[D21:15] Maria: I appreciate your kindness and care. It's a wonderful quality to have.
[D21:16] John: Thanks for the compliment, I really appreciate it!
[D21:17] Maria: No worries, John. Nice moments like these remind me how much kindness and compassion matter. Life can be challenging, but small acts of kindness can make a big difference.
[D21:18] John: Wow, that's awesome! What inspired it?
[D21:19] Maria: One of the shelter residents, Laura, wrote us a letter expressing their gratitude. The impact we made on their life was inspiring!
[D21:20] John: Wow, that's really amazing to hear. It feels so good to make a positive impact on someone's life.
[D21:21] Maria: Yeah, that's why I love volunteering! It makes me feel like I'm making a difference, even if it's a small one.
[D21:22] John: Yeah, Maria, keep it up! Even small things can mean a lot. I just participated in a marching event for veterans' rights and it was awesome, made me remember how much they sacrifice for us. We need to show our support however we can.
[D21:23] Maria: Wow, John! What inspired you to join it?
[D21:24] John: I've always had a great respect for our military and wanted to show my support. I think it's important to stand up for what we believe in.
[D21:25] Maria: Wow, John! It's great to see you standing up for your beliefs.
[D21:26] John: Thanks Maria, it was amazing being around others who shared the same values and passion as me. It reminded me how important it is to try and make a difference through activism. It really motivated me.
[D21:27] Maria: That's awesome, John! Surrounding yourself with determined people striving for the same goals can be really motivating. Keep it up!
[D21:28] John: Thanks, Maria! It really is. Striving for progress is crucial.
[D21:29] Maria: Yep John, Let's keep up the good work and make a difference. Talk to you soon!
[D22:1] John: Since the last chat, I've been thinking about how education and infrastructure shape communities. It's so sad how they can stunt growth in neighborhoods, but it also drives me to do what I can to make it better.
[D22:2] Maria: I totally agree. They play a crucial role in shaping communities. It's unfortunate to witness the negative effects when they are lacking, but it's inspiring to see your passion and proactive approach towards making a positive change.
[D22:3] John: Your support means a lot. Feeling like it's an uphill battle is tough, but it's great to know there are people out there who see the value in them - it keeps me going.
[D22:4] Maria: John, you got this! It's great to have a support system while tackling tough stuff. I'm here to lend an ear or help out however I can. You're really making a difference, and that's something to be proud of!
[D22:5] John: I appreciate it. It's really uplifting hearing from you. I sometimes doubt if I'm making a difference, but knowing there's people who understand my work means a lot and helps keep me going. Here's a picture of my family. They motivate me and remind me why I'm doing this.
[D22:6] Maria: That picture is awesome! Your family looks so stoked - your trip must have been incredible! They obviously motivate and support you.
[D22:7] John: Thanks, Maria! That picture was from a trip we took last year for my daughter Sara's birthday - so much fun and good memories! My family motivates me to keep striving for change.
[D22:8] Maria: Yeah, memories and motivators definitely help us stay on track and keep us going.
[D22:9] John: Yeah, for sure! When times get hard, I look at it and remember why I'm doing what I'm doing. My family is my motivation and they keep me going. What about you? What keeps you inspired?
[D22:10] Maria: I'm inspired by chatting to people, volunteering, and listening to music. Anything else that keeps you inspired?

[D22:12] Maria: That's great, John! It's true, we all have our own special sources of inspiration that keep us going.
[D22:13] John: Definitely, Maria! Finding those special sources is key for staying motivated and tackling challenges. It's great when we figure out what makes us feel excited and alive.
[D22:14] Maria: Yeah, John, those little things can spark our enthusiasm and motivate us. It's incredible how something as simple as a walk or a song can totally switch up our outlook.
[D22:15] John: Yeah, Maria. Little things like this can make a big impact in how we think. Oh, and here's a pic I got from my walk last week. It always reminds me to take a break, breathe, and appreciate nature.
[D22:16] Maria: That picture is amazing! The colors are so vibrant - really shows the calmness of the ocean. How often do you get to see sunsets like that on your walks?
[D22:17] John: Thanks, Maria! I see them at least once a week. It's a good way to disconnect, think, and find peace in this crazy world.
[D22:18] Maria: That's great practice, John. Taking time to detach and find peace is important in this crazy world. I've been taking regular "me-time" walks at the park nearby and It's made a big impact. Glad you have that to remind you.

[D22:20] Maria: Hey John, stay safe. Chat soon!

question: Select the one option that is still true after the conversation. Answer with one option letter only.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna! Long time no see! What's up? Anything fun going on?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate! Long time no see! I've been working on a project lately - it's been pretty cool. What about you - any fun projects or hobbies?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna! That's cool! I won my first video game tournament last week - so exciting!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow Nate! Congrats on winning! Tell me more - what game was it?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks! it's a team shooter game.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, great job! What was is called?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: The game was called Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, and me and my team had a blast to the very end!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Cool, Nate! Sounds like a fun experience, even if I'm not into games.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: It was! How about you? Do you have any hobbies you love?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yeah! Besides writing, I also enjoy reading, watching movies, and exploring nature. Anything else you enjoy doing, Nate?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Playing video games and watching movies are my main hobbies.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Cool, Nate! So we both have similar interests. What type of movies do you like best?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I love action and sci-fi movies, the effects are so cool! What about you, what's your favorite genre?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I'm all about dramas and romcoms. I love getting immersed in the feelings and plots.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow, movies can be so powerful! Do you have any recommendations for me?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yeah, totally! Have you seen this romantic drama that's all about memory and relationships? It's such a good one.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Oh cool! I might check that one out some time soon! I do love watching classics.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yep, that movie is awesome. I first watched it around 3 years ago. I even went out and got a physical copy!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sounds cool! Have you seen it a lot? sounds like you know the movie well!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: A few times. It's one of my favorites! I really like the idea and the acting.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Cool! I'll definitely check it out. Thanks for the recommendation!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: No problem, Nate! Let me know if you like it!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate! Haven't talked in a few days. Crazy things happened to me!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hi Joanna! Long time no see! What's been going on? You sound excited!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Woo! I finally finished my first full screenplay and printed it last Friday. I've been working on for a while, such a relief to have it all done!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow, that sounds awesome! What's it about? Glad it's all down!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! It's a mix of drama and romance!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow, that's amazing! How do you feel now that it's finished? Do you have any new plans for it?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Woohoo, Nate! I'm feeling a rollercoaster of emotions - relief, excitement, some anxiety - over finishing this project. Now I'm gonna submit it to some film festivals and (hopefully) get producers and directors to check it out. Here's hoping!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Congrats, Joanna! That sounds like a wild experience. Rock on and I hope they love it!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks Nate! A mix of emotions for sure. Hopefully, it leads to positive feedback and new opportunities.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah, for sure. Hoping for the best! I like having some of these little ones around to keep me calm when things are super important and I'm nervous.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Awww! How long have you had them?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I've had them for 3 years now and they bring me tons of joy!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: They sure lookl like they do! Adorable!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks! The turtles might be small, but both sure have big personalities. I really reccomend having something like these little guys for times of stress.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Good idea, Nate! I'll think about it and maybe get pets of my own soon if I can find any I'm not allergic to. Have you been up to anything recently?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah actually! I start to hang out with some people outside of my circle at the tournament. They're pretty cool!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Oh? That sounds sweet! Is it a weird relationship with them being competitors and all?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Oh, kind of. Some people are more competitive then others, so I tend to just stick around the more chill people here.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That makes sense! Are you gonna cheer them on even if you lose?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Absolutely! I don't expect to win big here, I just like playing for fun! You mentioned you were allergic to pets earlier, how bad is it?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Oh, its really bad. My face gets all puffy and itchy when I'm around certain animals, so I've always just stayed away.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sorry to hear that. Allergies can be tough. What specifically are you allergic to?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I'm allergic to most reptiles and animals with fur. It can be a bit of a drag, but I find other ways to be happy.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Awesome! There are lots of things that can bring you joy without pets. What else brings you joy?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Writing and hanging with friends! That way I can express myself through stories, or just have a good time with people.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That's great to hear! Those are both great things. I'm glad to hear you've got other things to help you get through times of axiousness despite not being able to have animals!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Writing helps me create wild worlds with awesome characters. Plus, it's a great way to express my feelings. I can't imagine life without it.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow, Joanna, that sounds amazing! Keep doing what you love!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! I'll definitely keep pursuing my passion for writing. It means a lot.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate, long time no see! The screenplay I sent in to the film festival has been on my mind all day everyday. I keep bouncing between crazy emotions like relief, excitement and worry! Fingers crossed a producer or director falls in love with it and it ends up on the big screen - that would be awesome!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna! It is a big deal! I'm sure its been a wild ride. Sending some positive vibes and hoping someone likes it enough to get it on the big screen - that would be awesome!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks Nate, your support really means a lot. I put a lot of effort into it and I'm crossing my fingers. What about you? Anything new and exciting happening in your life?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks, Joanna. Not much has changed for me, but I just discovered that I can make coconut milk icecream and gave it a try. It was actually pretty good, so I'm proud of myself.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Looks delish! Glad you tried something new and it went well. What did you think of it?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Super good! It was rich and creamy - might be my new favorite snack!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Great! I love when you try something new and it actually works out. Will you give it another go?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yep, it could be fun! I'm looking forward to trying out different flavors and toppings.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yum! Sounds great. Got any favorite flavors for dairy-free desserts?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I love coconut milk, but I also enjoy chocolate and mixed berry flavors.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, those sound great! Who can say no to chocolate and berries? I'm tempted to try dairy-free flavors now!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Well I also made a dairy-free chocolate cake with berries on it the other day, maybe you would like that!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow! That sounds yummy! You're so talented. Thanks for sharing your amazing creations! I should really try making one or just pay you a visit and try one for myself!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I couldn't agree more! It's always fun experimenting in the kitchen.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I can tell! Your cooking skills are awesome. Seen any good movies lately?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Not recently. Any good ones you'd recommend?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I just watched "Little Women" and it was amazing! It's a great story about sisterhood, love, and reaching for your dreams. Definitely a must-see!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Oh, that sounds like a great one! I'll definitely add it to my list. Thanks for the recommendation!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Anytime! I'm always down to give movie reccomendations.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Good to know! I'll be sure to give you a shout whenever I run out of things to watch!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sounds great! Let me know what you think of it when your done!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: You bet! You'll be the first to know.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Awesome! Enjoy yourself!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: You too, take care!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Later, take care!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna! Sorry I haven't been around. I made my friend some ice cream and they loved it!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: No worries, Nate! Glad to hear it. What flavor did you make?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I whipped up some chocolate and vanilla swirl.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That looks delicious! Unfortunately, I can't have dairy, so no ice cream for me. Do you happen to have a dairy-free recipe that I could try?

turns.text: Sure, I know one recipe using coconut milk. Would you like me to send it to you?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yeah, definitely! I'm keen to try your recipe. Always up for something sweet.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Cool, I'll do that. I'm all about these desserts, let me know what you think!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Definitely keeping you posted! Love your creations!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks, Joanna! It means a lot that you enjoy the desserts I bake.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yeah Nate, your cooking is amazing! I can't stop thinking about the screenplay, so I just started writing another one while I wait to hear back about how the first one did.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I hear that, taking your mind of something like that is very challenging. What's the new one about?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: It's about a thirty year old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss. Somewhat similar to the last one, but hey, that's just the kind of thing I'm inspired to write about!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Interesting! That's a deep topic. Love to hear more about it.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! It's my own story. The main character is dealing with some tough stuff: loss and trying to figure out who they are. They take a road trip to heal and grow.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow, Joanna, that sounds awesome. I love stories that tackle important issues. What inspired you to this one?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! It was inspired by personal experiences and my own journey of self-discovery.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow, Joanna, that takes guts! I can't wait to see it all come together. I'm also pumped to see how your first one will do!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Appreciate your support. Hoping my screenplay gets noticed and makes it to the screen. Fingers crossed!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Crossing my fingers for you! Hope your screenplay finds a fan and is given its due. Good luck!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate, it's been a minute! I wrapped up my second script, and the feels have been wild. Sometimes I'm so relieved, but other times I just feel anxious about what comes next. It's a mix of excitement and terror, thinking about my work getting noticed and hitting the big screen.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna! Awesome to hear from you! Congrats on wrapping up a second one! All that hard work and dedication will definitely shine through and get noticed, no doubt. Hope you've been able to take some time to relax after everything!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks Nate! It's been a wild ride. I've been decompressing, but it's hard to switch off. There's always this tug-of-war of hope and doubt.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: It's normal to have doubts, but you've worked hard and put tons of passion into it. Believe in yourself and things will work out. Here, look at this cute pic - walking them always reminds me to enjoy the small stuff!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That pic's adorable! They always look so relaxed outside. What made you choose them as pets?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I'm drawn to turtles. They're unique and their slow pace is a nice change from the rush of life. They're also low-maintenance and calming. Check out this moment I snapped!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: They look so peaceful! It's amazing how these creatures bring so much calm and joy. Is taking care of them tough?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: No, not really. Just keep their area clean, feed them properly, and make sure they get enough light. It's actually kind of fun.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sounds great! Having pets must be a wonderful experience.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Pets definitely bring tons of joy. They are always there for us and they're so cute! Relaxing with them is a great way to chill.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I wish I wasn't allergic! I would get two turtles today if I could! I found out recently I'm allergic to cockroaches as well, so who knows if I'll ever get a pet.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sorry! Maybe there are other animals you could consider! In the meantime though, I'll be sure to send you pics of my turtles so you can still watch them grow without getting too close.

turns.speaker: Joanna

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Pets really seem to do that to everyone don't they! So, what about your script now? Any ideas for the next steps?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I've been doing my fair share of research and networking non-stop for it. It's tough, but I'm determined to make it happen.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Great idea! that should hopefully get some more eyes on it. Keep up the hard work!

turns.text: Thanks so much, Nate! Your support means a lot. I'll keep working at it and hopefully the next steps will become clearer soon.

turns.speaker: Nate

turns.speaker: Nate

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Always good to hear! See you later!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Definitely! Read lots and try out different genres. Build a solid understanding of literature. Don't be afraid to write and share, even if it's just with friends. Practicing and gathering feedback will make you better. Have faith in yourself and continue following your writing dreams - it's tough but worth it.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks, Joanna. Really appreciate your help and kind words. I'm going to keep working hard on it and see what happens. Good luck with your project, I'm sure it will turn out great!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks Nate! Appreciate your kind words and support. Let's keep going for our dreams and work hard. Catch you later!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Bye Joanna! Take care!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That looks really good! I love the way the frosting turned out!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Appreciate all the help. Gonna keep trying new things. See ya later!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Bye!

expanded_dialogue_text:
[D1:1] Nate: Hey Joanna! Long time no see! What's up? Anything fun going on?
[D1:2] Joanna: Hey Nate! Long time no see! I've been working on a project lately - it's been pretty cool. What about you - any fun projects or hobbies?
[D1:3] Nate: Hey Joanna! That's cool! I won my first video game tournament last week - so exciting!
[D1:4] Joanna: Wow Nate! Congrats on winning! Tell me more - what game was it?
[D1:5] Nate: Thanks! it's a team shooter game.
[D1:6] Joanna: Wow, great job! What was is called?
[D1:7] Nate: The game was called Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, and me and my team had a blast to the very end!
[D1:8] Joanna: Cool, Nate! Sounds like a fun experience, even if I'm not into games.
[D1:9] Nate: It was! How about you? Do you have any hobbies you love?
[D1:10] Joanna: Yeah! Besides writing, I also enjoy reading, watching movies, and exploring nature. Anything else you enjoy doing, Nate?
[D1:11] Nate: Playing video games and watching movies are my main hobbies.
[D1:12] Joanna: Cool, Nate! So we both have similar interests. What type of movies do you like best?
[D1:13] Nate: I love action and sci-fi movies, the effects are so cool! What about you, what's your favorite genre?
[D1:14] Joanna: I'm all about dramas and romcoms. I love getting immersed in the feelings and plots.
[D1:15] Nate: Wow, movies can be so powerful! Do you have any recommendations for me?
[D1:16] Joanna: Yeah, totally! Have you seen this romantic drama that's all about memory and relationships? It's such a good one.
[D1:17] Nate: Oh cool! I might check that one out some time soon! I do love watching classics.
[D1:18] Joanna: Yep, that movie is awesome. I first watched it around 3 years ago. I even went out and got a physical copy!
[D1:19] Nate: Sounds cool! Have you seen it a lot? sounds like you know the movie well!
[D1:20] Joanna: A few times. It's one of my favorites! I really like the idea and the acting.
[D1:21] Nate: Cool! I'll definitely check it out. Thanks for the recommendation!
[D1:22] Joanna: No problem, Nate! Let me know if you like it!
[D2:1] Joanna: Hey Nate! Haven't talked in a few days. Crazy things happened to me!
[D2:2] Nate: Hi Joanna! Long time no see! What's been going on? You sound excited!
[D2:3] Joanna: Woo! I finally finished my first full screenplay and printed it last Friday. I've been working on for a while, such a relief to have it all done!
[D2:4] Nate: Wow, that sounds awesome! What's it about? Glad it's all down!
[D2:5] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It's a mix of drama and romance!
[D2:6] Nate: Wow, that's amazing! How do you feel now that it's finished? Do you have any new plans for it?
[D2:7] Joanna: Woohoo, Nate! I'm feeling a rollercoaster of emotions - relief, excitement, some anxiety - over finishing this project. Now I'm gonna submit it to some film festivals and (hopefully) get producers and directors to check it out. Here's hoping!
[D2:8] Nate: Congrats, Joanna! That sounds like a wild experience. Rock on and I hope they love it!
[D2:9] Joanna: Thanks Nate! A mix of emotions for sure. Hopefully, it leads to positive feedback and new opportunities.
[D2:10] Nate: Yeah, for sure. Hoping for the best! I like having some of these little ones around to keep me calm when things are super important and I'm nervous.
[D2:11] Joanna: Awww! How long have you had them?
[D2:12] Nate: I've had them for 3 years now and they bring me tons of joy!
[D2:13] Joanna: They sure lookl like they do! Adorable!
[D2:14] Nate: Thanks! The turtles might be small, but both sure have big personalities. I really reccomend having something like these little guys for times of stress.
[D2:15] Joanna: Good idea, Nate! I'll think about it and maybe get pets of my own soon if I can find any I'm not allergic to. Have you been up to anything recently?
[D2:16] Nate: Yeah actually! I start to hang out with some people outside of my circle at the tournament. They're pretty cool!
[D2:17] Joanna: Oh? That sounds sweet! Is it a weird relationship with them being competitors and all?
[D2:18] Nate: Oh, kind of. Some people are more competitive then others, so I tend to just stick around the more chill people here.
[D2:19] Joanna: That makes sense! Are you gonna cheer them on even if you lose?
[D2:20] Nate: Absolutely! I don't expect to win big here, I just like playing for fun! You mentioned you were allergic to pets earlier, how bad is it?
[D2:21] Joanna: Oh, its really bad. My face gets all puffy and itchy when I'm around certain animals, so I've always just stayed away.
[D2:22] Nate: Sorry to hear that. Allergies can be tough. What specifically are you allergic to?
[D2:23] Joanna: I'm allergic to most reptiles and animals with fur. It can be a bit of a drag, but I find other ways to be happy.
[D2:24] Nate: Awesome! There are lots of things that can bring you joy without pets. What else brings you joy?
[D2:25] Joanna: Writing and hanging with friends! That way I can express myself through stories, or just have a good time with people.
[D2:26] Nate: That's great to hear! Those are both great things. I'm glad to hear you've got other things to help you get through times of axiousness despite not being able to have animals!
[D2:27] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Writing helps me create wild worlds with awesome characters. Plus, it's a great way to express my feelings. I can't imagine life without it.
[D2:28] Nate: Wow, Joanna, that sounds amazing! Keep doing what you love!
[D2:29] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! I'll definitely keep pursuing my passion for writing. It means a lot.
[D3:1] Joanna: Hey Nate, long time no see! The screenplay I sent in to the film festival has been on my mind all day everyday. I keep bouncing between crazy emotions like relief, excitement and worry! Fingers crossed a producer or director falls in love with it and it ends up on the big screen - that would be awesome!
[D3:2] Nate: Hey Joanna! It is a big deal! I'm sure its been a wild ride. Sending some positive vibes and hoping someone likes it enough to get it on the big screen - that would be awesome!
[D3:3] Joanna: Thanks Nate, your support really means a lot. I put a lot of effort into it and I'm crossing my fingers. What about you? Anything new and exciting happening in your life?
[D3:4] Nate: Thanks, Joanna. Not much has changed for me, but I just discovered that I can make coconut milk icecream and gave it a try. It was actually pretty good, so I'm proud of myself.
[D3:5] Joanna: Looks delish! Glad you tried something new and it went well. What did you think of it?
[D3:6] Nate: Super good! It was rich and creamy - might be my new favorite snack!
[D3:7] Joanna: Great! I love when you try something new and it actually works out. Will you give it another go?
[D3:8] Nate: Yep, it could be fun! I'm looking forward to trying out different flavors and toppings.
[D3:9] Joanna: Yum! Sounds great. Got any favorite flavors for dairy-free desserts?
[D3:10] Nate: I love coconut milk, but I also enjoy chocolate and mixed berry flavors.
[D3:11] Joanna: Wow, those sound great! Who can say no to chocolate and berries? I'm tempted to try dairy-free flavors now!
[D3:12] Nate: Well I also made a dairy-free chocolate cake with berries on it the other day, maybe you would like that!
[D3:13] Joanna: Wow! That sounds yummy! You're so talented. Thanks for sharing your amazing creations! I should really try making one or just pay you a visit and try one for myself!
[D3:14] Nate: I couldn't agree more! It's always fun experimenting in the kitchen.
[D3:15] Joanna: I can tell! Your cooking skills are awesome. Seen any good movies lately?
[D3:16] Nate: Not recently. Any good ones you'd recommend?
[D3:17] Joanna: I just watched "Little Women" and it was amazing! It's a great story about sisterhood, love, and reaching for your dreams. Definitely a must-see!
[D3:18] Nate: Oh, that sounds like a great one! I'll definitely add it to my list. Thanks for the recommendation!
[D3:19] Joanna: Anytime! I'm always down to give movie reccomendations.
[D3:20] Nate: Good to know! I'll be sure to give you a shout whenever I run out of things to watch!
[D3:21] Joanna: Sounds great! Let me know what you think of it when your done!
[D3:22] Nate: You bet! You'll be the first to know.
[D3:23] Joanna: Awesome! Enjoy yourself!
[D3:24] Nate: You too, take care!
[D3:25] Joanna: Later, take care!
[D4:1] Nate: Hey Joanna! Sorry I haven't been around. I made my friend some ice cream and they loved it!
[D4:2] Joanna: No worries, Nate! Glad to hear it. What flavor did you make?
[D4:3] Nate: I whipped up some chocolate and vanilla swirl.
[D4:4] Joanna: That looks delicious! Unfortunately, I can't have dairy, so no ice cream for me. Do you happen to have a dairy-free recipe that I could try?
[D4:5] Nate: Sure, I know one recipe using coconut milk. Would you like me to send it to you?
[D4:6] Joanna: Yeah, definitely! I'm keen to try your recipe. Always up for something sweet.
[D4:7] Nate: Cool, I'll do that. I'm all about these desserts, let me know what you think!
[D4:8] Joanna: Definitely keeping you posted! Love your creations!
[D4:9] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! It means a lot that you enjoy the desserts I bake.
[D4:10] Joanna: Yeah Nate, your cooking is amazing! I can't stop thinking about the screenplay, so I just started writing another one while I wait to hear back about how the first one did.
[D4:11] Nate: I hear that, taking your mind of something like that is very challenging. What's the new one about?
[D4:12] Joanna: It's about a thirty year old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss. Somewhat similar to the last one, but hey, that's just the kind of thing I'm inspired to write about!
[D4:13] Nate: Interesting! That's a deep topic. Love to hear more about it.
[D4:14] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It's my own story. The main character is dealing with some tough stuff: loss and trying to figure out who they are. They take a road trip to heal and grow.
[D4:15] Nate: Wow, Joanna, that sounds awesome. I love stories that tackle important issues. What inspired you to this one?
[D4:16] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It was inspired by personal experiences and my own journey of self-discovery.
[D4:17] Nate: Wow, Joanna, that takes guts! I can't wait to see it all come together. I'm also pumped to see how your first one will do!
[D4:18] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Appreciate your support. Hoping my screenplay gets noticed and makes it to the screen. Fingers crossed!
[D4:19] Nate: Crossing my fingers for you! Hope your screenplay finds a fan and is given its due. Good luck!
[D5:1] Joanna: Hey Nate, it's been a minute! I wrapped up my second script, and the feels have been wild. Sometimes I'm so relieved, but other times I just feel anxious about what comes next. It's a mix of excitement and terror, thinking about my work getting noticed and hitting the big screen.
[D5:2] Nate: Hey Joanna! Awesome to hear from you! Congrats on wrapping up a second one! All that hard work and dedication will definitely shine through and get noticed, no doubt. Hope you've been able to take some time to relax after everything!
[D5:3] Joanna: Thanks Nate! It's been a wild ride. I've been decompressing, but it's hard to switch off. There's always this tug-of-war of hope and doubt.
[D5:4] Nate: It's normal to have doubts, but you've worked hard and put tons of passion into it. Believe in yourself and things will work out. Here, look at this cute pic - walking them always reminds me to enjoy the small stuff!
[D5:5] Joanna: That pic's adorable! They always look so relaxed outside. What made you choose them as pets?
[D5:6] Nate: I'm drawn to turtles. They're unique and their slow pace is a nice change from the rush of life. They're also low-maintenance and calming. Check out this moment I snapped!
[D5:7] Joanna: They look so peaceful! It's amazing how these creatures bring so much calm and joy. Is taking care of them tough?
[D5:8] Nate: No, not really. Just keep their area clean, feed them properly, and make sure they get enough light. It's actually kind of fun.
[D5:9] Joanna: Sounds great! Having pets must be a wonderful experience.
[D5:10] Nate: Pets definitely bring tons of joy. They are always there for us and they're so cute! Relaxing with them is a great way to chill.
[D5:11] Joanna: I wish I wasn't allergic! I would get two turtles today if I could! I found out recently I'm allergic to cockroaches as well, so who knows if I'll ever get a pet.
[D5:12] Nate: Sorry! Maybe there are other animals you could consider! In the meantime though, I'll be sure to send you pics of my turtles so you can still watch them grow without getting too close.
[D5:13] Joanna: Great idea! I'm already really invested in those little guys!
[D5:14] Nate: Pets really seem to do that to everyone don't they! So, what about your script now? Any ideas for the next steps?
[D5:15] Joanna: I've been doing my fair share of research and networking non-stop for it. It's tough, but I'm determined to make it happen.
[D5:16] Nate: Great idea! that should hopefully get some more eyes on it. Keep up the hard work!
[D5:17] Joanna: Thanks so much, Nate! Your support means a lot. I'll keep working at it and hopefully the next steps will become clearer soon.
[D5:18] Nate: Just make sure you don't quit - the path forward will show up soon. You got this!
[D5:19] Joanna: Appreciated! I think just having someone to support me throughout the whole process is such a blessing. It gives me the motivation to keep pushing forward.
[D5:20] Nate: Glad to hear my support makes a difference, Joanna. I'm here for you!
[D5:21] Joanna: Always good to hear! See you later!
[D6:1] Nate: Hey Joanna! Long time no talk, how's it going? Crazy stuff's been happening since we last chatted.
[D6:2] Joanna: Hey Nate! Been quite a ride - in a good way - had an audition yesterday for a writing gig.
[D6:3] Nate: Congrats! How did it go? Are you excited?
[D6:4] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It went alright. Mixed emotions - definitely excited but also a bit anxious. Keep those fingers crossed!
[D6:5] Nate: Yeah, I get it. Mixed emotions are rough, but I have faith in you! Keep me posted - you got this!
[D6:6] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Your support means a lot. I'll make sure to keep you updated. Anything new on your end?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I think about my life too sometimes when I'm out and about, but there was something special about these trails that made me feel like writing a drama.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey, we should go together sometime, don't you think? Maybe I'll start to think of a drama myself and publish my own screenplay.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Haha, now that would be something! Sure, you should come down and join me on the trails sometime!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sounds like a plan! Thanks for the invite Joanna!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sure thing Nate! See you later!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: See ya!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna! How've you been? Been a busy week since we talked.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate! Just finished something - pretty wild journey!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Way to go! I just got a new addition to the family, this is Max!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, he's adorable! How long have you had him? I can see why you're thrilled!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks! It's awesome - he's adopted and so full of energy, and he's filling my life with so much joy. He's even keeping my other pets active.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Pets sure do make life better! Glad Max is bringing you lots of joy.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yep, totally! Pets make us so much happier and never let us down. Have you thought any more of getting one of your own?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Unfortunately, allergies make it so I don't really want to get any, and I'm too lazy to research alternative pets for my allergies.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Aww, that's unfortunate. It's nice seeing the joy pets bring to others, though. How do you find comfort when you don't have any?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Writing and creative projects are what get me through tough times. I'm also grateful for my supportive friends.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow, that's awesome! Those both can definitely be therapeutic. It's great to have such positive relationships that make such a great impact.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yeah. It's so nice to have friends who understand and appreciate my work - it's priceless being able to talk about it together and receive feedback. Here's a look at what I've been working on – it's been quite a journey, but I made it!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow, that looks great Joanna! Is that your third one?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yep! I chose to write about this because it's really personal. It's about loss, identity, and connection. It's a story I've had for ages but just got the guts to write it. It was hard, but I'm so proud of it.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That sounds impressive. You really do like writing about sadness and loss don't you.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Yeah I really do. I had to be vulnerable and dig deep into those topics. But I think meaningful stories come from personal experiences and feelings. It was scary, but I found that I write best when I'm being true to myself - even if it's hard.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Well done, Joanna! It takes guts to explore your experiences and feelings. I'm proud of you for staying strong and being true to yourself. Keep it up!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Your support really means a lot. Knowing I've got people like you cheering me on makes this journey way easier.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: No worries, Joanna! Keep going and reach for your dreams. You've got tons of talent and potential!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Jo! Been ages since we last talked. Here's something cool that happened the other day - I took Max for a walk and ran into this super nice couple who had a dog. It turns out they live close by. We decided to do doggy playdates, which is awesome considering we all need friends for our pets.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate! Great to hear from you. Sounds like a nice encounter on your walk. Connecting with others who have pets can be uplifting and rewarding.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: It's like fate. Having a walking buddy forMax will be great. He really likes the other dog too!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Awesome! Did you get to know the couple very well? What were they like?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: They actually didn't share a whole lot in common with me besides the love of animals, but I think that was all we needed to share in common to be good friends!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That's really cool that you can just go out and meet people like that, keep it up Nate!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks! I just really enjoy watching our pets play with one another. Its like a dream come true seeing my dog so happy.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I can see why having a peaceful presence around could help relieve stress. Having someone or something to come home to for a sense of calm would be helpful for relaxation.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yep, Joanna. It's great! Looky here, I got this new pup for you!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Awww! It's so cute! I love the thought Nate!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks! It's a stuffed animal to remind you of the good vibes.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That's so sweet! I'll cherish that little guy with all my heart!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah! It's like having joy in your pocket. It always makes me grin when I look at it.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That's great, Nate! Appreciate the small joys like that cute stuffed animal. It's a nice reminder!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Agreed, those little things sure do make life better!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I'll always remember those moments that bring us happiness and remind us that life is great!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sure, Joanna! It's all about finding those little things and cherishing them, otherwise it's easy to get down!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thinking back to the tough times finishing my screenplay made me realize it's those moments that bring joy and make the journey worth it.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah, those little moments make it all worth it, especially during tough times. Enjoying the ride is key.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Appreciating the journey and being aware of those happy moments can be a game-changer! It keeps us focused on our dreams. Can't wait to show it to you. I value your opinion!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Can't wait to see it, Joanna! I'm here to support you.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Your support is greatly appreciated. I'll make sure to keep you updated.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: No worries! You've got this. Keep it up!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Nate, after finishing my screenplay I got a rejection letter from a major company. It really bummed me out.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sorry to hear that, Joanna. Rejection stinks, but it doesn't mean you're not talented. Don't give up on your dreams!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate. It can feel like a step back sometimes. But I appreciate your kind words and encouragement.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sure, just make sure you keep going and believing in yourself. Did something happen with the company?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: They just sent me a generic rejection letter without much feedback. It's disheartening not knowing why it didn't work out.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Ugh, that's so frustrating. But don't get discouraged, just keep going.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yeah, you're right. I won't let this bring me down. Thanks for your support. What have you been up to lately?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I've been doing great - I just won another regional video game tournament last week! It was so cool, plus I met some new people. Connecting with fellow gamers is always awesome.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Way to go, Nate! Congratulations on your victory in the tournament! It must feel great to be recognized for your gaming skills.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks, Joanna! Winning was a huge confidence boost and shows my hard work paid off. I'm really happy with my progress.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I am as well! It's great to hear from you about your tournaments throughout the years!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks! I has been a while since my first tournament hasn't it? I appreciate your support!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Anytime Nate! I'm here for you every step of the way.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I talked to some of the guys at the tournament afterwards, and they said they wanted to hang out later!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sounds like fun! It's good to have friends that share your interests!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: For sure! They asked for some tips in how to improve their game, so I said I could help.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Good on you for helping strangers out! Stepping outside your comfort zone is always great.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks, I just like helping people. Do you have any plans for the weekend?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yep, I'm hiking with some buddies this weekend. We're checking out a new trail with a rad waterfall. Can't wait! Do you have any fun plans?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sounds great! Have fun with that. I'm organizing a gaming party two weekends later - it'll be hectic but fun!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Oh? Are you going to invite your tournament friends?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Definitely! And some old friends and teamates from other tournaments.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sounds like fun, Nate! I wish you the best on your party. Have a blast!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks Joanna! I'm sure it'll be a blast. I'm even getting everyone custom controller decorations just for coming!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, I bet they'll love that! What a sweet idea.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I know right? Have a great hike. Take lots of pics! See ya later!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks Nate! See you later!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate! Yesterday was crazy cool - I wrote a few bits for a screenplay that appeared on the big screen yesterday! It was nerve-wracking but so inspiring to see my words come alive!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Congrats, Joanna! Seeing your hard work pay off like that must've felt amazing. I bet it was scary too, but awesome! You're so inspiring. By the way, last time we saw eachother, I noticed a spiderman pin on your purse. Is Spider-Man your favorite superhero, or do you have another fave?

expanded_dialogue_text:
[D11:15] Joanna: I think about my life too sometimes when I'm out and about, but there was something special about these trails that made me feel like writing a drama.
[D11:16] Nate: Hey, we should go together sometime, don't you think? Maybe I'll start to think of a drama myself and publish my own screenplay.
[D11:17] Joanna: Haha, now that would be something! Sure, you should come down and join me on the trails sometime!
[D11:18] Nate: Sounds like a plan! Thanks for the invite Joanna!
[D11:19] Joanna: Sure thing Nate! See you later!
[D11:20] Nate: See ya!
[D12:1] Nate: Hey Joanna! How've you been? Been a busy week since we talked.
[D12:2] Joanna: Hey Nate! Just finished something - pretty wild journey!
[D12:3] Nate: Way to go! I just got a new addition to the family, this is Max!
[D12:4] Joanna: Wow, he's adorable! How long have you had him? I can see why you're thrilled!
[D12:5] Nate: Thanks! It's awesome - he's adopted and so full of energy, and he's filling my life with so much joy. He's even keeping my other pets active.
[D12:6] Joanna: Pets sure do make life better! Glad Max is bringing you lots of joy.
[D12:7] Nate: Yep, totally! Pets make us so much happier and never let us down. Have you thought any more of getting one of your own?
[D12:8] Joanna: Unfortunately, allergies make it so I don't really want to get any, and I'm too lazy to research alternative pets for my allergies.
[D12:9] Nate: Aww, that's unfortunate. It's nice seeing the joy pets bring to others, though. How do you find comfort when you don't have any?
[D12:10] Joanna: Writing and creative projects are what get me through tough times. I'm also grateful for my supportive friends.
[D12:11] Nate: Wow, that's awesome! Those both can definitely be therapeutic. It's great to have such positive relationships that make such a great impact.
[D12:12] Joanna: Yeah. It's so nice to have friends who understand and appreciate my work - it's priceless being able to talk about it together and receive feedback. Here's a look at what I've been working on – it's been quite a journey, but I made it!
[D12:13] Nate: Wow, that looks great Joanna! Is that your third one?
[D12:14] Joanna: Yep! I chose to write about this because it's really personal. It's about loss, identity, and connection. It's a story I've had for ages but just got the guts to write it. It was hard, but I'm so proud of it.
[D12:15] Nate: That sounds impressive. You really do like writing about sadness and loss don't you.
[D12:16] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Yeah I really do. I had to be vulnerable and dig deep into those topics. But I think meaningful stories come from personal experiences and feelings. It was scary, but I found that I write best when I'm being true to myself - even if it's hard.
[D12:17] Nate: Well done, Joanna! It takes guts to explore your experiences and feelings. I'm proud of you for staying strong and being true to yourself. Keep it up!
[D12:18] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Your support really means a lot. Knowing I've got people like you cheering me on makes this journey way easier.
[D12:19] Nate: No worries, Joanna! Keep going and reach for your dreams. You've got tons of talent and potential!
[D13:1] Nate: Hey Jo! Been ages since we last talked. Here's something cool that happened the other day - I took Max for a walk and ran into this super nice couple who had a dog. It turns out they live close by. We decided to do doggy playdates, which is awesome considering we all need friends for our pets.
[D13:2] Joanna: Hey Nate! Great to hear from you. Sounds like a nice encounter on your walk. Connecting with others who have pets can be uplifting and rewarding.
[D13:3] Nate: It's like fate. Having a walking buddy forMax will be great. He really likes the other dog too!
[D13:4] Joanna: Awesome! Did you get to know the couple very well? What were they like?
[D13:5] Nate: They actually didn't share a whole lot in common with me besides the love of animals, but I think that was all we needed to share in common to be good friends!
[D13:6] Joanna: That's really cool that you can just go out and meet people like that, keep it up Nate!
[D13:7] Nate: Thanks! I just really enjoy watching our pets play with one another. Its like a dream come true seeing my dog so happy.
[D13:8] Joanna: I can see why having a peaceful presence around could help relieve stress. Having someone or something to come home to for a sense of calm would be helpful for relaxation.
[D13:9] Nate: Yep, Joanna. It's great! Looky here, I got this new pup for you!
[D13:10] Joanna: Awww! It's so cute! I love the thought Nate!
[D13:11] Nate: Thanks! It's a stuffed animal to remind you of the good vibes.
[D13:12] Joanna: That's so sweet! I'll cherish that little guy with all my heart!
[D13:13] Nate: Yeah! It's like having joy in your pocket. It always makes me grin when I look at it.
[D13:14] Joanna: That's great, Nate! Appreciate the small joys like that cute stuffed animal. It's a nice reminder!
[D13:15] Nate: Agreed, those little things sure do make life better!
[D13:16] Joanna: I'll always remember those moments that bring us happiness and remind us that life is great!
[D13:17] Nate: Sure, Joanna! It's all about finding those little things and cherishing them, otherwise it's easy to get down!
[D13:18] Joanna: Thinking back to the tough times finishing my screenplay made me realize it's those moments that bring joy and make the journey worth it.
[D13:19] Nate: Yeah, those little moments make it all worth it, especially during tough times. Enjoying the ride is key.
[D13:20] Joanna: Appreciating the journey and being aware of those happy moments can be a game-changer! It keeps us focused on our dreams. Can't wait to show it to you. I value your opinion!
[D13:21] Nate: Can't wait to see it, Joanna! I'm here to support you.
[D13:22] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Your support is greatly appreciated. I'll make sure to keep you updated.
[D13:23] Nate: No worries! You've got this. Keep it up!
[D14:1] Joanna: Nate, after finishing my screenplay I got a rejection letter from a major company. It really bummed me out.
[D14:2] Nate: Sorry to hear that, Joanna. Rejection stinks, but it doesn't mean you're not talented. Don't give up on your dreams!
[D14:3] Joanna: Thanks, Nate. It can feel like a step back sometimes. But I appreciate your kind words and encouragement.
[D14:4] Nate: Sure, just make sure you keep going and believing in yourself. Did something happen with the company?
[D14:5] Joanna: They just sent me a generic rejection letter without much feedback. It's disheartening not knowing why it didn't work out.
[D14:6] Nate: Ugh, that's so frustrating. But don't get discouraged, just keep going.
[D14:7] Joanna: Yeah, you're right. I won't let this bring me down. Thanks for your support. What have you been up to lately?
[D14:8] Nate: I've been doing great - I just won another regional video game tournament last week! It was so cool, plus I met some new people. Connecting with fellow gamers is always awesome.
[D14:9] Joanna: Way to go, Nate! Congratulations on your victory in the tournament! It must feel great to be recognized for your gaming skills.
[D14:10] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! Winning was a huge confidence boost and shows my hard work paid off. I'm really happy with my progress.
[D14:11] Joanna: I am as well! It's great to hear from you about your tournaments throughout the years!
[D14:12] Nate: Thanks! I has been a while since my first tournament hasn't it? I appreciate your support!
[D14:13] Joanna: Anytime Nate! I'm here for you every step of the way.
[D14:14] Nate: I talked to some of the guys at the tournament afterwards, and they said they wanted to hang out later!
[D14:15] Joanna: Sounds like fun! It's good to have friends that share your interests!
[D14:16] Nate: For sure! They asked for some tips in how to improve their game, so I said I could help.
[D14:17] Joanna: Good on you for helping strangers out! Stepping outside your comfort zone is always great.
[D14:18] Nate: Thanks, I just like helping people. Do you have any plans for the weekend?
[D14:19] Joanna: Yep, I'm hiking with some buddies this weekend. We're checking out a new trail with a rad waterfall. Can't wait! Do you have any fun plans?
[D14:20] Nate: Sounds great! Have fun with that. I'm organizing a gaming party two weekends later - it'll be hectic but fun!
[D14:21] Joanna: Oh? Are you going to invite your tournament friends?
[D14:22] Nate: Definitely! And some old friends and teamates from other tournaments.
[D14:23] Joanna: Sounds like fun, Nate! I wish you the best on your party. Have a blast!
[D14:24] Nate: Thanks Joanna! I'm sure it'll be a blast. I'm even getting everyone custom controller decorations just for coming!
[D14:25] Joanna: Wow, I bet they'll love that! What a sweet idea.
[D14:26] Nate: I know right? Have a great hike. Take lots of pics! See ya later!
[D14:27] Joanna: Thanks Nate! See you later!
[D15:1] Joanna: Hey Nate! Yesterday was crazy cool - I wrote a few bits for a screenplay that appeared on the big screen yesterday! It was nerve-wracking but so inspiring to see my words come alive!
[D15:2] Nate: Congrats, Joanna! Seeing your hard work pay off like that must've felt amazing. I bet it was scary too, but awesome! You're so inspiring. By the way, last time we saw eachother, I noticed a spiderman pin on your purse. Is Spider-Man your favorite superhero, or do you have another fave?
[D15:3] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It was a real roller coaster, but seeing the hard work pay off was amazing. Spider-Man has always been a favorite of mine - I mean, who doesn't love Peter Parker's struggles between being a hero and being a person? But I'm kind of a sucker for any superhero - everyone has their own rad story and powers. Do you have a favorite superhero?
[D15:4] Nate: That's great, Joanna! Iron Man is my top pick. I love his tech and that sarcastic humor. Seeing these figures just makes me feel invincible!
[D15:5] Joanna: Wow, Nate! That's awesome. I love the tech and funny jokes of Iron Man too. What made you get that figure?
[D15:6] Nate: Thanks Joanna! I got it because it reminded me of something I love. Its presence in my room is a good reminder to keep working on my goals. Any inspiring things in your room?
[D15:7] Joanna: My cork board is full of inspiring quotes and pictures for motivation and creativity. It's my little corner of inspiration.
[D15:8] Nate: Wow Joanna, that sounds great! Could you show me a picture of it?
[D15:9] Joanna: Here ya go, a pic of my cork board. It's got quotes, photos, and little keepsakes.
[D15:10] Nate: That's a great pic of your family! What made you hang it on your cork board?
[D15:11] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Having that picture on my cork board reminds me of the love and encouragement from them every day.
[D15:12] Nate: That's great, Joanna. Family support is invaluable. It's so good to have those reminders.
[D15:13] Joanna: Absolutely, it means a lot and keeps me going.
[D15:14] Nate: I really should start a cork board of my own shouldn't I. That seems like a really valuable thing!
[D15:15] Joanna: I would definitely recommend it! As long as your willing to explain what it is to your friends.
[D15:16] Nate: Of course! Well see you later Joanna!
[D15:17] Joanna: Bye Nate!
[D16:1] Joanna: Hey Nate, long time no see! How have you been? I just got done submitting my recent screenplay to a film contest just to see how others might like it!
[D16:2] Nate: That's really cool Joanna! I hope it does well, and I've been doing great! The gaming party was a great success! We even played some Chess afterward just for fun.
[D16:3] Joanna: Nice! Did your friends like the controller accessories?
[D16:4] Nate: Most of them did! I can't say if all of them will continue to use them or not, but that's beside the point.
[D16:5] Joanna: Yeah Nate, you're right. It doesn't matter if they use it, its the thought that matters right?
[D16:6] Nate: Absolutely! There were 7 people that attended, and 6 of them said they'd want to do it again next month!
[D16:7] Joanna: That sounds like a huge success then! Congrats!
[D16:8] Nate: Thanks! On another note, I made vegan ice cream last Friday and shared it with some people in my vegan diet group. It was awesome!
[D16:9] Joanna: Mm, yum! Can you give me the recipe for that? It sounds like it'd be a good recipe!
[D16:10] Nate: Sure thing! I can give it to you tomorrow, how does that sound?
[D16:11] Joanna: Awesome! I'm going to make it for my family this weekend - can't wait!
[D16:12] Nate: Nice one, Joanna! Hope you and your family like it. Let me know how it went!
[D16:13] Joanna: Sure thing! They love it when I make them new things!
[D16:14] Nate: Then I have no doubt they'll love the icecream!
[D16:15] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Your support is greatly appreciated. I'll make sure to keep you updated.
[D16:16] Nate: Can't wait to hear about it. Have a great day! Take care.
[D17:1] Nate: Hey Joanna, check this out! I won my fourth video game tournament on Friday! It was awesome competing and showing off my skills - and the victory was indescribable. I'm really proud that I can make money doing what I love. This one was online!
[D17:2] Joanna: Congrats, Nate! That's awesome! So proud of you. Your hard work really paid off - keep it up! BTW, I took a road trip for research for my next movie while you were winning. Much-needed break and a chance to explore new places and get inspired.
[D17:3] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! Your support means a lot to me. That road trip sounds great! Where did you go? Did you discover any interesting places?
[D17:4] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Appreciate your kind words. I went to Woodhaven, a small town in the Midwest. Got to see some lovely scenery and historic buildings. Checked out the library there, it had a cool old book collection!
[D17:5] Nate: That place looks interesting! Did you find any cool books there?
[D17:6] Joanna: I stumbled upon this super cool book from the 1900s with stories and sketches - so awesome to read about the town and the people living there!
[D17:7] Nate: That sounds really interesting! Anyting specific stick out to you about it?
[D17:8] Joanna: Woodhaven has had an interesting past with lots of cool people. Seeing how much it changed sparked ideas for my next script.
[D17:9] Nate: Real-life stories are the best for inspiration. Can't wait to hear about your next one. Keep it up!
[D17:10] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! I'm stoked about this new script. It's different from my previous work, but it has the potential to be something awesome! I'll be sure to keep you posted.
[D17:11] Nate: I'm sure it will do just as well as your last one! Keep on trying and believe in yourself!
[D17:12] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Your encouragement really means a lot to me. You're the best for supporting me in my writing journey.
[D17:13] Nate: I'm always here for you! You've got so much talent, just keep going for it!
[D17:14] Joanna: I will! I actually started on a book recently since my movie did well!
[D17:15] Nate: Nice! I'm curious, what is it about?
[D17:16] Joanna: That page specifically has some dialogues exploring loss, redemption, and forgiveness. It's a deep and emotional story that I'm really excited about!
[D17:17] Nate: Wow, Joanna! It sounds awesome. I'm so excited to see how it all plays out!
[D17:18] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! I'm so glad you're excited. I've never really tried publishing a book, but this might be the first!
[D17:19] Nate: Good luck on that! I'm sure people will recognise you as the same author of the movie you got published and love the book even more.
